sanskrit: pramucyamānaṃ bhuvanasya gopaḥ paśuṃ no atra prati bhāgam etu | agnir yajñaṃ trivṛtaṃ saptatantuṃ devo devebhyo havyaṃ vahatu prajānan ||
english: The guardian of the world, as it is being released — let the sacrificial animal come here to receive our share. May Agni, the knowing god, carry the threefold, seven-stranded oblation to the gods from the sacrifice.

sanskrit: yau te daṃṣṭrau sudihau ropayiṣṇū nir hvayete dakṣiṇāḥ saṃ ca paśyataḥ | anāṣṭraṃ naḥ pitaras tat kṛṇotu yūpe baddhaṃ pramumucimā yad annam ||
english: Your two well-smeared tusks that are ever growing, the right-side ones call out and look upon it together — may the Fathers make that free of evil for us; we would release the food that is bound to the sacrificial post.

sanskrit: ahrastas tvam aviduṣṭaḥ parehi- -indrasya goṣṭham api dhāva vidvān | dhīrāsas tvā kavayaḥ saṃ mṛjantv iṣam ūrjaṃ yajamānāya matsva ||
english: You are undiminshed, unspoiled — go forth! Run, knowing one, into Indra's cow-pen. Let the wise seers wipe you clean; be glad of nourishment and strength for the sacrificer.

sanskrit: ṛṣibhiṣ ṭvā saptabhir atriṇāhaṃ prati gṛhṇāmi bhuvane syonam | jamadagniḥ kaśyapaḥ svādv etad bharadvājo madhv annaṃ kṛṇotu | pratigrahītre gotamo vasiṣṭho viśvāmitro daduṣe śarma yacchāt ||
english: I receive you here, pleasant in the world, through the seven seers who consume — Jamadagni, Kaśyapa, Bharadvāja — let him make this food sweet as honey. May Gautama, Vasiṣṭha, and Viśvāmitra grant shelter to the receiver, to the giver.

sanskrit: yan no agraṃ haviṣa ājagāma- -annasya pātram uta sarpiṣo vā | yad vā dhanaṃ vahator ājagāma- -agniṣ ṭad dhotā suhutaṃ kṛṇotu ||
english: Whatever foremost portion of the oblation has come to us — the vessel of food or of ghee — or whatever wealth has arrived from those two who convey it, may Agni the hotar make that well-offered.

sanskrit: yad ājyaṃ pratijagrabha yāṃś ca vrīhīn ajaṃ candreṇa saha yaj jaghāsa | bṛhaspatir haviṣo no vidhartā mā no hiṃsīc chāgo aśvo vaśā ca ||
english: The clarified butter that was received, and the rice grains that the goat consumed together with the moon — may Bṛhaspati be the apportioner of our oblation; may the goat, the horse, and the cow not harm us.

sanskrit: agnir na etat prati gṛhṇātu vidvān bṛhaspatiḥ praty etu prajānan | indro marutvān suhutaṃ kṛṇotv ayakṣmam anamīvaṃ te astu ||
english: May Agni knowingly receive this for us; may Bṛhaspati, fully knowing, respond. May Indra with the Maruts make it well-offered; may it be free of consumption, free of disease for you.

sanskrit: yan no dadur varāham akṣitaṃ vasu yad vā talpam upadhānena naḥ saha | yad vāviyūthaṃ saha vṛṣṇyā no agniṣ ṭad dhotā suhutaṃ kṛṇotu ||
english: Whatever imperishable wealth they have given us in the form of a boar, or a bed together with its cushion for us, or whatever vigor along with virile strength — may Agni the hotar make that well-offered.

sanskrit: yan naḥ śālāṃ viśvabhogām imāṃ dadur gṛhaṃ vā yoktraṃ saha kṛttyota | yad vā hara upanāhena devā agniṣ ṭad dhotā suhutaṃ kṛṇotu ||
english: Whatever all-providing hall, or house, or rope together with its woven mat, or whatever golden ornament along with its fastening the gods have given us — may Agni the hotar make that well-offered.

sanskrit: sūrye varca iti yac chuśravāhaṃ yena prajā jyotiragrāś caranti | some varco yad goṣu varco mayi devā rāṣṭrabhṛtas tad akran ||
english: The luster in the sun — that which I have heard of, by which people go with radiance at their fore — the luster in Soma, the luster in the cows: may the gods, the upholders of sovereignty, place that in me.

sanskrit: yajñe varco maruto yad adṛṃhan vāyuḥ paśūn asṛjat saṃ bhagena | gandharvāṇām apsarasāṃ yad apsu mayi (…) ||
english: The luster that the Maruts strengthened in the sacrifice, that Vāyu released among the cattle together with good fortune, the luster of the Gandharvas and the Apsarases in the waters — [may the gods place] that in me.

sanskrit: yajñe varco yajamāne ca varca udābhiṣikte rājani yac ca varcaḥ | dakṣiṇāyāṃ varco adhi yan (…) ||
english: The luster in the sacrifice and luster in the sacrificer, the luster that is in the king who has been consecrated with ablution, the luster that is foremost in the sacrificial fee — [may the gods place] that in me.

sanskrit: rathe varco rathavāhane ca varca iṣudhau varcaḥ kavace ca varcaḥ | aśveṣu varco adhi yan (…) ||
english: Luster in the chariot, luster in the horse that draws the chariot, luster in the quiver, luster in the armor, the luster that is foremost among the horses — [may the gods place] that in me.

sanskrit: sabhāyāṃ varcaḥ samityāṃ ca varco vadhvāṃ varca uta varco vareṣu | surāyāṃ varco adhi yan (…) ||
english: Luster in the assembly hall, luster in the council, luster in the bride, and luster in the act of choosing, the luster that is foremost in the ceremonial drink — [may the gods place] that in me.

sanskrit: siṃhe varca uta varco vyāghre vṛke varco madhuhāre ca varcaḥ | śyene varcaḥ patvanāṃ yad babhūva (…) ||
english: Luster in the lion, luster in the tiger, luster in the wolf, luster in the honey-gatherer, the luster of the eagle among flying creatures — [may the gods place] that in me.

sanskrit: hiraṇyavarcasam uta hastivarcasaṃ saṃgrāmaṃ yaj jajñuṣāṃ varca āhuḥ | kṛṣyāṃ kṣetra ṛṣayo janyānajur mayi devā rāṣṭrabhṛtas tad akran ||
english: The golden luster and the luster of the elephant, the luster they speak of in battle, of those who have conquered, which the seers have proclaimed in cultivated fields and in the field of the born — may the gods, the upholders of sovereignty, place that in me.

sanskrit: mayi varco mayi śravo mayi dyumnaṃ mayi tviṣiḥ | adhaspadaṃ pṛtanyavo 'haṃ bhūyāsam uttamaḥ ||
english: In me be luster, in me be fame, in me be brilliance, in me be fiery energy. May I be the highest, my enemies beneath my feet.

sanskrit: payasvatīr oṣadhayaḥ payasvan māmakaṃ vacaḥ | atho payasvatāṃ paya ā harāmi sahasraśaḥ ||
english: The plants are full of milk; milky too is my speech. I draw the milk of the milk-laden ones here by the thousand.

sanskrit: ahaṃ veda yathā payaś cakāra dhānyaṃ bahu | saṃbhṛtvā nāmā yo devas taṃ vayaṃ yajāmahe sarvasyāyajvano gṛhe ||
english: I know how he made the milk and made the grain abundant. The god who bears the name Saṃbhṛtā — him we worship, in the house of every non-sacrificer.

sanskrit: yathā dyauś ca pṛthivī ca tasthatur dharuṇāya kam | evā sphātiṃ ni tanomi mayāreṣu khaleṣu ca ||
english: As heaven and earth have stood firm for the sake of a support, so I spread prosperity on the threshing floors and the granary floors.

sanskrit: yathā kūpaḥ śatadhāraḥ sahasradhāro akṣitaḥ | evā me astu dhānyaṃ sahasradhāram akṣitam ||
english: As a well has a hundred streams, a thousand streams, and is inexhaustible, so may my grain be of a thousand streams and inexhaustible.

sanskrit: śatahasta samāhara sahasrahasta saṃ kira | yatheha sphātir āyati kṛtasya kāryasya ca ||
english: With a hundred hands gather in; with a thousand hands pour together — so that prosperity may come here for what has been done and what is yet to be done.

sanskrit: imā yāḥ pañca pradiśo mānavīḥ pañca kṛṣṭayaḥ | sarvāḥ śaṃbhūr mayobhuvo vṛṣṭe śāpaṃ nadīr iva- -iha sphātiṃ samāvahān ||
english: These five human regions, these five peoples — all of them, auspicious and joy-giving, after rain like rivers that shed curse, may they bring prosperity together here.

sanskrit: iha sphātir oṣadhīnāṃ devānām uta saṃgamaḥ | ihaivāśvinor astu dvāparāśvo ruhat ||
english: Here is the prosperity of plants and the meeting of the gods. Right here may the dice-horse of the Aśvins spring up at the turning point.

sanskrit: tisro mātrā gandharvāṇāṃ catasro gṛhapatnyāḥ | tāsāṃ yā sphātir uttamā tayā tvābhi mṛśāmasi ||
english: Three are the measures of the Gandharvas, four of the mistress of the household. With the highest prosperity among these, we touch you.

sanskrit: jyeṣṭhasya tvāṅgirasasya hastābhyām ā rabhāmahe | yathāsad bahudhānyam ayakṣmaṃ bahupūruṣam ||
english: With the hands of Āṅgirasa the eldest we take hold of you, so that there may be abundant grain, freedom from consumption, and many men.
